---

### RemoteModuleDescriptor

```ts
type RemoteModuleDescriptor = Readonly<{
  description?: string;
  operations: Readonly<Record<string, RemoteOperationDescriptor>>;
}>;
```

A module's operations keyed by their dotted path below the module, for a host
that runs the module in another isolate. Identity, alias and placement stay the
host's decision; this carries only what the model may call.
